question: 5 men and 6 women can earn ₹10,500 in 6 days. 8 men and 12 women can earn ₹24,800 in 8 days. In how many days will 7 men and 10 women earn ₹26,500?
solution:
**Given:**

5 men and 6 women can earn ₹10,500 in 6 days. 

8 men and 12 women can earn ₹24,800 in 8 days. 

**Calculation:**

5 men and 6 women can earn Rs. 10500 in 6 days

5 men and 6 women can earn Rs. 1750 in 1 day

10 men and 12 women can earn Rs. 3500 in 1 day

Again,

8 men and 12 women can earn Rs. 24800 in 8 days

8 men and 12 women can earn Rs. 3100 in 1 day

So, 2 men can earn in 1 day = (3500 - 3100) = 400

1 man can earn Rs. 200 in 1 day

1 woman can earn in 1 day = (1750 - 1000)/6 = 125

So,

7 men and 10 women earn in 1 day = 200 × 7 + 10 × 125

⇒ 1400 + 1250

⇒ 2650

So, they will earn 26500 in 26500/2650 = 10 days

**∴ Required time is 10 days**
